source-integrity.tradability: validated by current Workgraph identity/tradability projection
source-integrity.freshness: Q2 FY2027 primary results dated 2026-09-03; current valuation observed 2026-09-25
source-integrity.provenance: issuer/SEC operating evidence plus independent S&P Global-derived market data
source-integrity.duplicateOriginCollapse: repeated Q2 issuer origin treated once
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: valuation evidence is independent of issuer operating claims

company-underwriting.operatingFinancialTrajectory: Current packet records double-digit ARR growth and positive GAAP operating income; independent market data shows TTM revenue about $1.72B, up 15%, with positive net income.
company-underwriting.contractsBacklogCustomersSuppliers: ARR supports recurring demand visibility, but current evidence does not isolate agentic-product ARR or customer concentration.
company-underwriting.balanceSheetRunwayDebtDilution: Independent market data shows enterprise value below market cap and shares down 1.85% YoY, reducing near-term financing/dilution concern; detailed debt maturity evidence remains limited.
company-underwriting.managementGovernanceCapitalAllocation: Operating discipline improved, while leadership changes announced with Q2 results create transition risk.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: Enterprise automation/governance integration supports moderate pricing power, but hyperscaler/application-suite bundling constrains stronger assumptions.
company-underwriting.catalystsRisks: Agentic orchestration adoption and continued ARR/profitability conversion are catalysts; substitution, leadership transition and uncertain agentic mix are key risks.

thesisQuality.basis: Double-digit ARR growth and profitable operating evidence support real enterprise automation demand, while agentic-specific adoption remains unquantified.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 evidence shows ARR growth and positive GAAP operating income; current independent data shows TTM revenue growth near 15%.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: At 2026-09-25 PATH traded near $12.46, about $6.49B market cap, 3.77x sales and 18.42x trailing earnings, providing plausible headroom without requiring exceptional outcomes.

catalystScore.basis: Agentic orchestration commercialization and continued ARR/profitability conversion are identifiable catalysts, but product-specific adoption remains unquantified.

governancePower.basis: Improved operating discipline is offset by leadership-transition risk and limited current evidence on long-duration capital allocation.

alignment2036.basis: Governed orchestration of AI agents, robots and enterprise workflows addresses a durable automation/control need.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: A common platform spans RPA, APIs, agents, process orchestration and intelligence across enterprise workflows.

bottleneckControl.basis: Governance and deterministic automation create workflow friction, but hyperscalers and application vendors can bundle competing orchestration.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Automation remains useful across multiple AI adoption paths, though value capture depends on UiPath retaining orchestration relevance.

substitutionResilience.basis: Installed automation workflows create switching friction, but credible bundled substitutes prevent a strong-band assessment.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Software delivery limits physical supply-chain dependence; current evidence does not justify exceptional infrastructure redundancy claims.

pricingPower.basis: Recurring enterprise software economics support some pricing flexibility, but competitive bundling and unquantified product mix cap the assessment.

riskEvidence.basis: Key risks are bundled substitution, leadership transition and uncertain agentic-product contribution despite improving profitability.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Primary Q2 evidence supports operations and independent current market data supports valuation; agentic-product ARR, concentration and detailed capital structure remain incompletely disclosed in current lineage.

scoreRecord.thesis: UiPath has credible recurring automation demand and improving operating discipline with meaningful 2036 relevance in governed agentic workflows; moderate valuation and substitution risk keep the thesis below exceptional.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Hyperscalers and enterprise application suites can bundle orchestration/governance while UiPath has not yet isolated agentic-product ARR.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Evidence of sustained ARR growth, profitable conversion and quantified adoption of agentic orchestration products.
